scripts.build: npm run build -w caelus && npm run stats:golden && npm run facts:sync && npm run build -w caelus-delineations-pd && npm run build -w caelus-corpus && npm run build -w caelus-mcp && npm run build -w caelus-birth && npm run build -w caelus-wheel && npm run build -w caelus-widgets && npm run docs:api && npm run search:index && npm run build -w web
scripts.test: npm run test -w caelus && npm run test -w caelus-delineations-pd && npm run test -w caelus-corpus && npm run test -w caelus-birth && npm run test:wheel && npm run test -w caelus-widgets && npm run test:mcp
scripts.test:wheel: npm run test -w caelus-wheel && node packages/wheel/dist/test/sphere.test.js && node packages/wheel/dist/test/astromap.test.js && node packages/wheel/dist/test/ephemerisgraph.test.js && node packages/wheel/dist/test/multiwheel.test.js && node packages/wheel/dist/test/integration.test.js
scripts.test:mcp: node packages/caelus-mcp/smoke.mjs && node packages/caelus-mcp/verify_tools.mjs && node packages/caelus-mcp/integration.test.mjs && node packages/caelus-mcp/eval/run.mjs

scripts.test:web: export NEXT_DIST_DIR=.next-ci; npm run build -w caelus-mcp && npm run docs:api && npm run search:index && npm run build -w web && npm run smoke:web
scripts.preflight: npm run check:versions && node scripts/check-tarball.mjs && node scripts/check-docs.mjs && node scripts/check-mcp-surface.mjs && npm run test && npm run lint:prose && npm run lint:emdash && npm run facts:sync && npm run lint:claims && node scripts/test-web-libs.mjs && npm run test:web
